newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen heading higher at opening.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen heading higher at opening.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open higher on Friday, with many investors focusing on an announcement by General Motors that it will sell its Hughes Aircraft unit to Raytheon, analysts said.
But they said it was not certain that GM's stock would rally strongly on the news.
"This deal highlights General Motors's non-auto businesses and it is favourable for the company," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities.
